1.web: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
1.asv: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

2.web: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its breadth and what is its length.”
2.asv: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

3.web: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,
3.asv: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

4.web: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
4.asv: and said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as villages without walls, by reason of the multitude of men and cattle therein.

5.web: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.
5.asv: For I, saith Jehovah, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.

6.web: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.
6.asv: Ho, ho, flee from the land of the north, saith Jehovah; for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heavens, saith Jehovah.

7.web: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
7.asv: Ho Zion, escape, thou that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

8.web: For thus says Yahweh of Armies: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
8.asv: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: After glory hath he sent me unto the nations which plundered you; for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

9.web: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.
9.asv: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they shall be a spoil to those that served them; and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me.

10.web: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for, behold, I come, and I will dwell in your midst,’ says Yahweh.
10.asv: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion; for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

11.web: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell in your midst, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.
11.asv: And many nations shall join themselves to Jehovah in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

12.web: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
12.asv: And Jehovah shall inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

13.web: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
13.asv: Be silent, all flesh, before Jehovah; for he is waked up out of his holy habitation.
